answer: ClinicalTrials.gov records trial-level and, for posted results, arm-level outcomes, but it does not provide a common, comparable field for comparative efficacy across studies. Sponsors define different endpoints, units, and analysis windows, so there is no registry-based way to say whether pembrolizumab works better than nivolumab for melanoma.
